map.变异系数比较 使用指南: Coefficient of Variation Comparison User Guide
map.变异系数比较工具：输入两组数据的均值与标准差，计算变异系数 CV 消除量纲后比较: The coefficient of variation comparison tool takes the mean and standard deviation of two datasets, computes CV to remove units, and compares their dispersion — for comparing variability across different units.
map.变异系数 CV 用标准差除以均值绝对值，消除量纲后比较两组数据的相对离散程度。C: The coefficient of variation CV divides the standard deviation by the absolute mean, removing units so the relative dispersion of two datasets can be compared. A larger CV means more violent relative fluctuation; when two groups differ in unit or magnitude, comparing CV is more sensible than comparing standard deviations directly.
map.比较两组数据的相对离散度（CV=σ/|μ|）。: Compare the relative dispersion of two datasets (CV = σ/|μ|).
map.均值差异大时判断哪组更\"不稳\"。: When the means differ a lot, judge which group is "less stable".
map.CV 大者相对波动更大。: A larger CV means greater relative fluctuation.
map.：组1 μ=100、σ=10 → CV=10%；组2 μ=50、σ=8 → CV: : group 1 has μ=100, σ=10 → CV=10%; group 2 has μ=50, σ=8 → CV=16%. Even though group 2 has the smaller σ, its relative fluctuation is larger.
map.：A 年化 10%、σ 12%（CV120%）；B 年化 5%、σ 6%（CV1: : A has a 10% annual return with σ of 12% (CV 120%); B has 5% with σ of 6% (CV 120%). With the same CV the risk-return ratio is identical.
map.防均值负时 CV 误号；通常用绝对值衡量相对波动大小。: Guards against a misleading CV sign when the mean is negative; the absolute value is normally used to measure relative fluctuation.
map.和标准差比？: How Does It Compare to the Standard Deviation?
map.标准差是绝对离散，CV 是相对离散，跨量纲/跨均值比较必须用 CV。: The standard deviation is absolute dispersion and CV is relative; comparing across units or means requires CV.
